**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 5 minutes

[Sauce]{.badge .badge-sauce} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*Sweet, tangy, and savory. Perfect for dipping fried food!*

## Ingredients

- 6 tbsp ketchup
- 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
- 2 tbsp oyster sauce
- 2 tbsp miso paste (optional)
- 2 tsp honey

## Instructions

1. In a small bowl, stir together all of the ingredients until fully incorporated.
2. Use or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.
